assumptions_and_boundaries: The uniform epsilon premise is assumed, not established: forall rational eps>0, exists N, forall finite triangle-free H with card H>=N, there exists a cut with normalized cost <=2/47+eps.

The epsilon quantifier precedes N and the universal graph quantifier. N may depend on eps but not on the chosen large H. The eventual claim must cover all relevant density regimes, or the separately justified middle interval plus exact outside branches.
Balanced blow-up must be positive and preserve triangle-freeness. The retained theorem is threshold-parametric for every rational B, so B=2/47+eps is permitted.

The neighbor-cut proof assumes only a finite simple triangle-free graph and n>0. The empty graph is separate. It does not assume regularity, maximum-cut optimality, minimum degree, or a stability theorem.
All new graph and transport arguments are hand-checked mathematics. They have not been added to Lean. No BCL coefficient identity or positivity witness was checked.
The existing 2587/100000 sparse-half endpoint remains conditional on BCL and is an attributed existing constant. The conjectural 1/50 result remains open in this work.
The acquisition record supports absence only in the finite inspected set. It does not establish global unavailability, nonexistence, or falsehood of the theorem.

quantifier_and_integer_gap_review.argument: Fix nonempty G with n vertices, choose eps=1/(94*n^2)>0, obtain N from the uniform premise, and take k=N+1. Then k>0 and k*n>=N. Apply the premise to the triangle-free balanced blow-up and the exact threshold-parametric equivalence to descend its cut bound. For integer cut cost d, d<=2*n^2/47+1/94. Thus integer 47*d-2*n^2<=1/2, so it is <=0. Empty G has cost zero.
quantifier_and_integer_gap_review.gap_units: A positive unnormalized gap d-2*n^2/47 is at least 1/47. The corresponding normalized gap is at least 1/(47*n^2). The chosen eps is half this normalized minimum gap.
quantifier_and_integer_gap_review.not_sufficient: A fixed nonzero residual, unquantified solver tolerance, or a bound on one unrelated graph sequence does not supply the required premise.

neighbor_cut_review.argument: For every v, triangle-freeness makes N(v) independent. Therefore every edge incident to u in N(v) crosses the cut (N(v), complement), and its crossing count is C_v=sum_{u in N(v)} deg(u). Double counting gives sum_v C_v=sum_u deg(u)^2. Cauchy-Schwarz and sum_u deg(u)=2m give average C_v>=4*m^2/n^2. Select v with at least this average; its internal cost is <=m-4*m^2/n^2. Divide by n^2 to get g(r)=r/2-r^2.
neighbor_cut_review.coverage: The source near-2/5 range has r>=2/5-2/10^8>49/125. This removes its omitted stability computations only for the weaker target 2/47. It does not establish the stronger 1/25 branch or certify middle densities.
